rationale: Correct the existing project-company record to its legal identity and complete its sponsor-ownership history. Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric Limited Partnership is the single operating/project entity for the 192 MW Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station; its holdcos, lenders, municipal co-licensee and facility names are not separate PortCos or equity owners. Brookfield Renewable affiliates hold the 75% economic balance and managing/control position. ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V first invested in 2011 and transferred its then-current 25% project interest on July 8, 2021 to ArcLight Renewable Infrastructure Fund SM SPV, L.P.; the Fund V period is therefore historical and the continuation vehicle is the current 25% owner. ArcLight continues to list Catalyst Old River as current, Brookfield's March 2026 reporting still reflects the 25% third-party interest in The Catalyst Group, and April 2026 FERC filings continue to group Catalyst with Brookfield Renewable entities. No later sale, signed exit or pending ownership change was identified through August 13, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric
beforeImage.description: Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric owns the Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station on the Mississippi River near Vidalia, Louisiana. The asset serves utility and municipal offtakers through an asset-heavy hydro generation model supported by long-duration contractual arrangements. Public financing materials describe the facility as a 192 MW hydro plant with power sales to an Entergy subsidiary and the Town of Vidalia through contracts extending to 2031. The project is a long-life essential power asset rather than a diversified development platform, and reviewed sources do not disclose a separate project-company founding year. ArcLight has identified Catalyst Old River as a current investment, while public sources do not disclose the current ownership percentages at the asset level.

milestones.event: The Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station entered commercial operation.
ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V originally acquired an interest in the Sidney Murray hydro project.
Prudential Private Capital invested $60 million in a refinancing tied to the hydro asset and its holding structure.
ArcLight announced the closing of a continuation fund that contemporaneously acquired a 25% interest in the 192 MW Sidney Murray hydro project from an older ArcLight fund.

afterImage.name: Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric Limited Partnership
aliases: Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station
afterImage.description: Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric Limited Partnership owns and operates the 192 MW Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station on a diversion of the Mississippi River near Vidalia, Louisiana. The run-of-river facility entered service in 1990 and sells power to an Entergy utility and the Town of Vidalia under long-term arrangements extending through 2031. Brookfield Renewable affiliates hold the 75% economic balance and the managing/control position. ArcLight Capital Partners holds the remaining 25% through ArcLight Renewable Infrastructure Fund SM SPV, L.P., which acquired the interest from ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V on July 8, 2021. The project company is the single PortCo; its upstream holdcos, co-licensee and lenders are not separate owners.
